en: Hiya! I'm working on bringing Pokémon back from ancient Fossils.
Oh! You have a Fossil there, don't you? Shall I bring it back to life for you?
Right! Leave it with me. This will take a little while.
Go for a walk round the island, then come back. It'll be ready by then!
There you are! Your Fossil came back to life as {thing}!
Look after it. It's been waiting a very long time to see the world.
But your team is full! Make room, and come back for it.
If you ever find a Fossil, bring it to me. I'll show you what it used to be!
No? Well, the machine will be here if you change your mind.
